description: CLI-first audio and video orchestration with correlated subtitles, speaker models and source-linked exploration.

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Observed behavior differs from its contract

milestones.title: M1 - Local media to subtitles
milestones.description: S001-S007: three-OS CLI, runtime ownership, supported catalog/storage adapters, encrypted credentials and model registry, early metadata/date capture, library and correlated local subtitles.

milestones.title: M2 - Pipelines, speakers and desktop
milestones.description: S008-S010: configurable providers, speakers/terms and GUI with CLI.

milestones.title: M3 - Evidence and exploration
milestones.description: S011-S013: LadybugDB/ArcadeDB graph queries, timeline, saved views and optional AI suggestions.

milestones.title: M4 - Durable release delivery
milestones.description: S014: portable backups, acquisition expansion and release/docs promotion.

milestones.title: M5 - Speaker models
milestones.description: S015: elective speaker training, immutable corpus snapshots and speaker-associated model retrieval. May proceed once speaker/adapter contracts are established.

issues.title: S001: Prove native platform and dependency contracts
issues.acceptance: Prove CLI/runtime/GUI IPC, Cueson, a pinned Ladybug/SQLite combination, PostgreSQL/S3/ArcadeDB adapter contract feasibility, hidden launch, secret-store availability and offline docs on Windows, macOS and Linux. Record exact dependency pins and architecture support.

issues.title: S002: Establish workspace ownership and runtime interfaces
issues.acceptance: Implement platform paths, workspace discovery and ownership/locking. Establish shared CLI/runtime configuration and operation interfaces, job attempts, cancellation/retry contracts, redacted diagnostics and hidden noninteractive child launches. Define the catalog and storage boundaries consumed by subsequent slices. Depends on S001.

issues.title: S003: Implement portable catalogs and durable job state
issues.acceptance: Implement SQLite by default and full PostgreSQL parity for settings, operational state, metadata and associations. Provide portable migrations, transactions, durable jobs and attempt ownership, recovery receipts and a revisioned graph outbox. Reserve speaker segment/corpus, training-run and model-artifact associations in the schema. Prove the same state/recovery contracts on both catalogs. Depends on S002.

issues.title: S004: Implement filesystem and generic S3 artifact storage
issues.acceptance: Implement filesystem storage by default and full generic S3-compatible parity through one artifact contract. Support immutable writes, references, checksums, staged publication and recovery; publish verified bytes before catalog references. Resolve credential IDs through the shared secret-provider interface without persisting secret values in storage configuration. Prove the adapter contract on filesystem and an S3-compatible fixture. Depends on S003.

issues.title: S005: Implement encrypted credentials and the local model registry
issues.acceptance: Implement credential IDs, native secret stores and the documented encrypted fallback with status-only display and explicit replacement. Wire configured storage/provider authentication through secret references. Implement model manifests, version/digest checks, download receipts and organized model storage through the artifact adapter. Keep credentials out of persisted job configuration and logs. Depends on S003 and S004.

issues.title: S006: Build the unified audio and video library
issues.acceptance: Import immutable source inputs into verified canonical audio and one current validated CueJSON when selected; capture early raw metadata/date provenance, preserve required tracks/channels/timing, known-speaker mappings and intentional rosters. Retire application-owned original video and redundant subtitle intermediates only after accepted authority commits. URL/embedded acquisition is configured and receives no mandatory per-item review. Depends on S003, S004 and S005.

issues.title: S007: Produce correlated local subtitles through Cueson
issues.acceptance: Derive mapped audio, accept supplied tracks, run local recognition, retain source-timed speaker segment records, generate real subtitle source bytes and validate/render via Cueson. Prove timing, overlap and resumability; resolve zero-cue compatibility explicitly. Configured transforms proceed without mandatory review. Depends on S006.

issues.title: S008: Configure pipeline presets and provider adapters
issues.acceptance: Expose readable local/hosted presets, capability checks, per-stage model/endpoint overrides, encrypted credential setup and no silent provider fallback. Run configured jobs/routing without repeated permission; capability and error handling apply to the affected operation. Depends on S005 and S007.

issues.title: S009: Track speaker continuity and transcription terms
issues.acceptance: Separate acoustic voices from identities, maintain aliases and reversible corrections, compile exact term/name context before recognition and support configured transcript revisions. Link cross-library audio segments to revisioned speaker attributions and saved corpus-selection policies, including overlap/quality/provenance filters without mandatory sample review. Depends on S008.

issues.title: S010: Ship GUI packages with CLI parity and offline help
issues.acceptance: Package GUI plus CLI on all three OSes, wrap one shared core with no GUI-only logic, expose library/jobs/pipelines/speakers/terms, metadata/date controls, correlated playback and release-matched offline help. Record a capability matrix and any advanced/experimental CLI-first lag. Depends on S009.

issues.title: S011: Publish source-backed graph evidence and queries
issues.acceptance: Chunk real cues through adapters, validate assertions, publish idempotent LadybugDB and ArcadeDB projections with full common query parity and provide word/speaker/time/direct queries with provenance. Depends on S003 and S009.

issues.title: S012: Add all-media timelines and saved graph views
issues.acceptance: Render calendar and media-relative timelines, undated/approximate entries, source playback, savable queries and force-directed result views with accessible alternatives. Depends on S010 and S011.

issues.title: S013: Suggest queries through optional AI assistance
issues.acceptance: Route prompts/schema through the user's chosen adapter, show suggestions by default, support explicitly elected validated read-only auto-run with configured limits, and retain direct queries when assistance is disabled. Invalid/unsupported queries do not execute. Depends on S008 and S012.

issues.title: S014: Complete portability and release delivery
issues.acceptance: Implement portable backup/export across supported filesystem/S3, SQLite/PostgreSQL and LadybugDB/ArcadeDB backends, acquisition expansion, native package integrity/notices, signing as configured and exact release/docs promotion with brief highlights. Depends on S010 and S012.

issues.title: S015: Train and retrieve optional speaker-associated models
issues.acceptance: Let a user elect a training pipeline from a saved speaker corpus, snapshot exact segment/attribution revisions and preprocessing, run local/selected hosted training adapters without mandatory sample approval, and retain validation/provenance receipts. Store immutable versioned artifacts associated with the originating speaker and expose speaker-filtered models list/show and exact-version fetch through the CLI. Final GUI model presentation remains undecided and explicitly documented. Depends on S005, S008 and S009.
